name: El Burgo de Ebro (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and red with a broader red fly, charged on the red with the crowned arms of El Burgo de Ebro (a lion on red and a cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of El Burgo de Ebro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Burgo de Ebro arms — lion on red and a cross on white above waves
crown and lion of the arms
